kutipan: Started before dawn on a cold trail, then watched the morning open from Andong together.

items.caption: Basecamp Pendem, Magelang. Still cold when we started walking.
items.alt: Early morning atmosphere at Basecamp Pendem, Mount Andong

kutipan: Still out of breath. Good spot to stop for a minute.

items.caption: Stopped for a minute at the start of the ridge with a lollipop before the long uphill.
items.alt: Posing in a pink jacket while holding a lollipop against the green ridge trail of Mount Andong

items.caption: Fixing wind-blown hair while looking over at Merbabu and Merapi across the valley.
items.alt: Back view in a pink jacket facing the silhouettes of Mount Merbabu and Merapi over a green valley

items.caption: Turned around with a smile to make sure we were still walking close.
items.alt: Looking back with a smile and a backpack on, with the Mount Andong savanna trail in the background

items.caption: Tired from the climb, still stopped to make faces by the side of the trail.
items.alt: Selfie of two people making funny faces and sticking out their tongues while holding a lollipop by the trailside

items.caption: The narrow ridge trail on Andong was already filling up with morning hikers.
items.alt: View of the narrow green ridge trail of Mount Andong with a line of hikers and a summit direction sign

items.caption: Stopped on the dirt and rock steps, turning to the camera still holding the lollipop.
items.alt: Looking at the camera on the rocky savanna trail of Mount Andong while biting a lollipop stick, with a morning valley backdrop

items.judul: Merbabu and Merapi Across the Valley
items.caption: Standing by the edge of the savanna with Merbabu and a faint plume from Merapi behind us.
items.alt: Side view in a pink jacket holding a lollipop against the silhouettes of Mount Merbabu and Merapi

items.caption: You could see the rice fields down in the valley, with Merbabu and Merapi behind them.
items.alt: Close side view from behind a shoulder looking at the silhouettes of Mount Merbabu and Merapi over a valley of rice fields

items.judul: Savanna Clip: In Front of Merbabu
items.caption: Short clip on the ridge as the camera pulls back to show Merbabu and Merapi behind us.
items.alt: Short video of smiling while holding a lollipop on the Mount Andong savanna with Mount Merbabu and Merapi in the background

items.judul: Savanna Clip: "Is That a Photo or Video?"
items.caption: Kept holding a pose thinking it was a photo, not knowing it was recording video.
items.alt: Candid video of posing playfully in front of the camera while thinking it is a photo on the Mount Andong savanna

kutipan: No photos here. We were too busy climbing.
narasi: It was steeper than it looked.
Just footsteps on gravel and a few stops to catch our breath.

kutipan: Made it up. Time to sit down for a bit.

items.caption: Reached the Alap-Alap summit marker and grabbed the wooden sign after the last uphill.
items.alt: Photo of two people flanking the green Alap-Alap summit marker on Mount Andong while holding the MT Andong wooden sign

items.caption: Photo together under the Sunrise Camp sign after coming up via Pendem, with Merbabu and Merapi behind us.
items.alt: Photo of two people under the wooden Sunrise Camp 1704 Mdpl sign on Mount Andong with Mount Merbabu in the background

items.caption: Ran into a friendly grey cat at the summit and stopped to pet its head.
items.alt: Crouching to pet a soft grey mountain cat at the summit of Mount Andong

items.caption: Morning photo in the sun near the tents as other hikers started waking up.
items.alt: Morning selfie in the sunlight among the tents at the summit of Mount Andong

items.caption: Matching claw and tongue-out pose at the summit under a clear morning sky.
items.alt: Selfie of two people making claw and tongue-out poses under a bright blue sky at the summit of Mount Andong

items.caption: Hands tucked in jacket pockets against the cold, hair in the wind, laughing a bit.
items.alt: Candid video of smiling and laughing in the morning summit wind of Mount Andong

items.caption: Empty slot for extra summit photos.
items.alt: Placeholder for the seventh summit photo

items.caption: Empty slot for extra summit photos.
items.alt: Placeholder for the eighth summit photo

kutipan: We hoped for a sea of clouds. Got a clear blue sky instead, and it was still great.

items.caption: Met some hikers from abroad at the top and took a photo together.
items.alt: Taking photos with international hikers at the summit of Mount Andong under a clear blue sky with thin clouds

items.caption: The green ridge trail of Mount Andong in full morning sun.
items.alt: View of the green ridge trail of Mount Andong under bright sunlight and a clear blue sky

items.caption: Eating ice cream together under the Indonesian flagpole with Merbabu behind us.
items.alt: Posing together holding ice cream cones under the Red and White flagpole with Mount Merbabu in the background

items.judul: Ice Cream Line at the Summit
items.caption: Stood in a long line along the ridge just to get summit ice cream.
items.alt: Hikers queuing on the ridge of Mount Andong waiting for their turn to buy summit ice cream

items.judul: Jacket on the Bag & Peace Sign
items.caption: Once it warmed up, the pink jacket went onto the backpack, followed by a quick double peace sign.
items.alt: Funny video of a pink jacket tied to a backpack then turning around smiling with a two-finger peace pose

items.caption: From a quick finger heart to watching the vendor scoop a three-flavor cone at the top.
items.alt: Video of buying a three-flavor ice cream cone directly at the summit of Mount Andong

items.caption: Empty slot for extra clear sky photos.
items.alt: Placeholder for the seventh clear sky photo

items.caption: Empty slot for extra clear sky photos.
items.alt: Placeholder for the eighth clear sky photo

narasi: I thought there would be clouds below us.
At least we got a clear view of Merbabu.

kutipan: Morning colors that never look quite the same on camera.

items.caption: The morning sun coming up slowly through thin mist in the east.
items.alt: Sunrise from Mount Andong above a misty valley

items.caption: The sky was still dark blue before sunrise, with house lights still on at the foot of Merbabu.
items.alt: View of dark blue dawn with the silhouette of Mount Merbabu and village lights in the valley below

items.caption: Cold morning air and quiet laughs as the valley lights met the first orange light behind Merbabu and Merapi.
items.alt: Video of blue dawn at Mount Andong with valley lights and the silhouettes of Mount Merbabu and Merapi

kutipan: Tiring climb, good company. Until the next mountain.

items.caption: One last photo at the summit before heading back down.
items.alt: Closing photo of two people at Sunrise Camp on Mount Andong
